hero.sub: On a mission to reduce ocean-bound plastic through patented processes and responsible manufacturing.

reasons.heading: Three reasons to choose OCEOS
reasons.tagline: One reusable bag replaces 150+ single-use bags

items.title: Better bags for a better world
items.body: Since 2007, Oceos has been an innovator in wholesale manufacturing of customized, sustainable and reusable bags. Today every product we make has a positive impact on the earth and society.

items.title: Made from recycled plastic
items.body: Custom reusable shopping bags that serve a greater purpose than toting products. Brands put their name on these bags for their whole lifecycle, and become part of the effort to reduce plastic waste.

items.title: Stewardship and quality, hand in hand
items.body: Raw materials like hemp, jute and plastic recovered from beaches and waterways. And a fair wage for the people who source those materials and make our products.

statement.heading: From linear.|To circular.
body: Our mission: eliminate single-use plastic with scalable, traceable and beautifully engineered reusable packaging for the world's leading brands.

Closed-loop manufacturing of reusable rPET non-woven bags, sourced from recycled plastic bottles and food packaging. Over 20 years of experience, patented technology and partnerships with major global retailers.

products.heading: Reusable|sustainable|packaging.
products.body: Sturdy, lightweight, washable and reusable. Every bag fully customizable to meet your brand's sustainability goals.

items.title: rPET Non-Woven
items.description: Made from recycled plastic bottles and certified rPET. Sturdy, lightweight, washable and reusable. Fully customizable to your brand.

items.title: Non-Woven PP
items.description: Synthetic fibers in virgin or recycled polypropylene, bonded with high-quality hand stitching and reinforced at the seams and handles.

items.title: Ultrasonic rPET
items.description: The world's first ultrasonic rPET non-woven bag. Oceos commissioned the first machine able to make it in 2021. Before that, no manufacturer anywhere could.

items.title: Stitched Bags
items.description: Non-woven, woven, rPET, cotton and nylon constructions, stitched for daily use. Over a billion made.

process.heading: Closed|loop,|again and again.
process.body: Plastic collected, repurposed and put back into the economy. One bag lasts 3 to 5 years at about 50 trips a year.

steps.title: Collection
steps.description: Ocean-bound PET and post-consumer industrial plastics.

steps.title: Recycling
steps.description: Sorted, cleaned and converted into rPET pellets.

steps.title: Fabric
steps.description: Pellets made into durable, printable rPET non-woven fabric.

steps.title: Manufacturing
steps.description: Reusable rPET bags designed and produced with patented technology.

steps.title: Distribution
steps.description: Clients, including major retailers, roll bags out in sustainability programs.

steps.title: Reuse and return
steps.description: Consumers reuse or return the bags. Some programs recollect and reprocess them.

items.title: Material sourcing
items.description: Certified suppliers for recycled PET from bottles and ocean-bound waste streams.

items.title: Traceable manufacturing
items.description: Every step from pellet to finished bag is tracked. Full transparency for brands and ESG reporting.

items.title: Customization and branding
items.description: A wide range of sizes, printing options and finishes to tell your sustainability story.

items.title: Quality and compliance
items.description: Facilities meet global manufacturing standards (GRS, ISO and more) and follow socially responsible practices.

items.title: Delivery and support
items.description: Retail-ready bags, ongoing logistics and sustainability performance data.

clients.heading: Trusted|by the biggest names|around the globe.
clients.body: From grocery chains to luxury houses, retailers use Oceos bags to cut single-use plastic and prove it to their boards.

faq.heading: Straight answers.
faq.body: So you can move forward with confidence.

items.q: What are your bags made from?
items.a: Certified rPET from recycled plastic bottles and ocean-bound waste, virgin or recycled non-woven PP, and natural fibers like hemp and jute. Cotton and nylon on request.

items.q: How long does one bag last?
items.a: 3 to 5 years with normal use. At about 50 trips a year that's 150 to 250 uses, replacing 150+ single-use bags and saving 5.6 kg CO2e (medium bag, 150 uses).
GRS (Global Recycled Standard), ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001, BRCGS, Social Accountability International, and amfori membership.

items.q: Can you report on our program's impact?
items.a: Yes. Every step from pellet to finished bag is tracked, and we provide sustainability performance data for ESG reporting.

items.q: Can the bags carry our branding?
items.a: Yes. Sizes, printing options and finishes are all customizable to tell your sustainability story.
U.S. based, serving global clients. Tell us about your program and our team will work with you from design to delivery.

cta.heading: Let's start|a conversation.
cta.body: Launching a retail program, building a sustainability initiative or piloting a closed-loop solution? We help brands switch to reusable packaging without compromise on design, scale or performance.
